# 1 Kings Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was after these things. A-vineyard was to-Naboth the-Jezreelite, that was in-Jezreel, beside the-palace-of Ahab king-of Samaria.

**2** And-Ahab spoke to-Naboth, saying, "Give to-me your-vineyard, and-it-will-be to-me for-a-garden-of herbs, for it is near beside my-house. And-I-will-give to-you in-its-place a-vineyard better than-it; or if it-is-good in-your-eyes, I-will-give to-you its-price in-silver."

**3** And-Naboth said to-Ahab, "Far-be-it from-me by-YHWH, from-giving the-inheritance-of my-fathers to-you."

**4** And-Ahab came to his-house sullen and-angry because-of the-word that Naboth the-Jezreelite spoke to-him, for-he-said, "I-will-not give to-you the-inheritance-of my-fathers." And-he-lay-down on his-bed and-turned ʾet-his-face and-would-not eat bread.

**5** And-Jezebel his-wife came to-him and-spoke to-him, "Why is your-spirit sullen, and-you-are-not eating bread?"

**6** And-he-spoke to-her, "Because I-spoke to-Naboth the-Jezreelite and-said to-him, 'Give to-me your-vineyard for-silver, or if you-desire, I-will-give to-you a-vineyard in-its-place.' And-he-said, 'I-will-not give to-you my-vineyard.'"

**7** And-Jezebel his-wife said to-him, "You — now you exercise kingship over Israel? Arise, eat bread, and-let-your-heart be-good. I will-give to-you ʾet-the-vineyard-of Naboth the-Jezreelite."

**8** And-she-wrote letters in-the-name-of Ahab and-sealed-them with-his-seal, and-sent the-letters to the-elders and-to the-nobles who were in-his-city, who-dwelt with Naboth.

**9** And-she-wrote in-the-letters, saying, "Proclaim a-fast and-seat Naboth at-the-head-of the-people.

**10** And-seat two men, sons-of worthlessness, opposite-him, and-let-them-testify against-him, saying, 'You-cursed God and-the-king.' And-take-him-out and-stone-him, and-let-him-die."

**11** And-the-men-of his-city — the-elders and-the-nobles who-dwelt in-his-city — did as Jezebel had-sent to-them, as was-written in-the-letters that she-sent to-them.

**12** They-proclaimed a-fast and-seated Naboth at-the-head-of the-people.

**13** And-the-two men, sons-of worthlessness, came and-sat opposite-him. And-the-worthless men testified against-him, against Naboth, before the-people, saying, "Naboth cursed God and-the-king." And-they-took-him-out outside the-city and-stoned-him with-stones, and-he-died.

**14** And-they-sent to Jezebel, saying, "Naboth has-been-stoned and-is-dead."

**15** And-it-was when-Jezebel heard that Naboth had-been-stoned and-was-dead, and-Jezebel said to-Ahab, "Arise, take-possession-of the-vineyard-of Naboth the-Jezreelite that he-refused to-give to-you for-silver, for Naboth is-not alive but dead."

**16** And-it-was when-Ahab heard that Naboth was-dead, and-Ahab arose to-go-down to the-vineyard-of Naboth the-Jezreelite, to-take-possession-of-it.

**17** And-the-word-of YHWH came to Elijah the-Tishbite, saying,

**18** "Arise, go-down to-meet Ahab king-of Israel, who is in-Samaria. Behold — he is in-the-vineyard-of Naboth, where he-has-gone-down to-take-possession-of-it.

**19** And-speak to-him, saying, 'Thus says YHWH: Have-you-murdered and-also taken-possession?' And-speak to-him, saying, 'Thus says YHWH: In-the-place where the-dogs licked ʾet-the-blood-of Naboth, the-dogs will-lick your-blood — even yours.'"

**20** And-Ahab said to-Elijah, "Have-you-found-me, my-enemy?" And-he-said, "I-have-found-you, because you-sold-yourself to-do the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH.

**21** Behold — I am-bringing evil upon-you, and-I-will-sweep-after-you and-cut-off from-Ahab every male, bond and-free, in-Israel.

**22** And-I-will-make your-house like the-house-of Jeroboam son-of Nebat and-like the-house-of Baasha son-of Ahijah, because-of the-provocation with-which you-provoked and-caused Israel to-sin.

**23** And-also concerning Jezebel YHWH spoke, saying, 'The-dogs will-eat Jezebel in-the-plot-of Jezreel.'

**24** The-one-belonging-to-Ahab who-dies in-the-city, the-dogs will-eat, and-the-one-who-dies in-the-field, the-birds-of the-heavens will-eat."

**25** There-was-surely-none like-Ahab, who sold-himself to-do the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH, whom Jezebel his-wife incited.

**26** And-he-acted-very-abominably, going after the-idols, according-to-all that the-Amorites did, whom YHWH dispossessed from-before the-sons-of Israel.

**27** And-it-was when-Ahab heard ʾet-these words, and-he-tore his-garments and-put sackcloth on his-flesh, and-fasted, and-lay in-sackcloth, and-walked softly.

**28** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-Elijah the-Tishbite, saying,

**29** "Have-you-seen how Ahab has-humbled-himself before-me? Because he-humbled-himself before-me, I-will-not bring the-evil in-his-days. In-the-days-of his-son I-will-bring the-evil upon his-house." 

---
## EMET Textual Notes

1. **21:3 — "the-inheritance-of my-fathers"**: Naboth's refusal is not stubbornness but Torah obedience. Leviticus 25:23 forbids permanent sale of ancestral land — the land belongs to YHWH.
2. **21:7 — "You — now you exercise kingship?"**: Jezebel's contemptuous question reveals her foreign concept of monarchy: in Phoenicia, the king takes what he wants. In Israel, the king is under Torah.
3. **21:19 — "murdered and-also taken-possession"**: Two crimes in one sentence — murder and theft. The covenant violation is double, and so is the judgment.
4. **21:25 — "sold-himself"**: The Hebrew hitmaker — Ahab literally marketed himself for evil. Jezebel was the inciter, but Ahab was the willing buyer.
5. **21:29 — Ahab's repentance**: The most wicked king in Israel's history genuinely humbles himself — and God responds with mercy. Even Ahab is not beyond grace, though the judgment is only postponed, not cancelled.

— EMET
